h1: Photo Booth Hire Ilford and Across Redbridge
intro: Boothdrop Entertainment brings photo booth hire to Ilford and the rest of Redbridge in East London, with an attendant, props, prints and free delivery to banqueting suites, hotels and halls. Packages from £239 suit anything from an intimate birthday to a wedding spread over several days, and our setup time is never taken out of your hire.

sections.heading: Advice for multi-day Asian weddings in Ilford
paragraphs: Asian weddings are at the heart of our work in Ilford, and they rarely happen on a single evening. A mehndi or sangeet, the wedding day itself and a reception or walima can fall across several days and different rooms, each with its own guest list, which may run to several hundred people. Tell us which functions you want covered when you enquire, and we will quote each one with its own hire window and finish time, so the booth is running when the dance floor fills rather than at a standard slot.

Privacy matters to many families, and it shapes the booth choice. The enclosed Party Booth has a curtain and wood-panelled walls, and the Inflatable Booth surrounds guests in a lit enclosure, so neither puts poses on show to the whole hall. On request we also run a ladies' session, reserving the booth for women guests during a part of the evening you choose. It is no surprise that these two booths lead our Asian wedding photo booth Ilford bookings, with print templates designed in two languages or around the couple's monogram and matched to the decor.
list: Quote each function separately: mehndi, sangeet, wedding day, reception
Bilingual or monogram print templates in your decor colours
An attendant who keeps queues moving with several hundred guests
Late finishes quoted to the real end time

sections.heading: Which booth suits a Redbridge celebration
paragraphs: Magic mirror hire Ilford enquiries come mostly from receptions, where the full-length mirror, with its animations and games playing on screen, becomes a talking point, prints for every guest and fills the guest book as the night goes on. Up to eight people fit in one shot, which suits large family groups. In a function room where floor space is tight, the Selfie Mirror Pod offers the same mirror effect on a slim stand, with a DSLR and instant prints, inside a two-metre square.

For a birthday in a community hall or a children's party in a school hall, the LCD SlimPod is the lowest-cost option in our range: an open-air pod with a ring light, smart background removal, virtual props, GIFs and boomerangs. The Retro Pod's classic photo strips suit a nostalgic theme, and the digital-only GIF Booth is the pick for a launch or office event where guests want content on their phones rather than prints.

sections.heading: Gants Hill, Seven Kings and the rest of the borough
paragraphs: Ilford sits in the London Borough of Redbridge in East London, and we cover the whole borough as standard. That includes Ilford town centre, Gants Hill, Seven Kings, Goodmayes, Barkingside and Newbury Park, as well as Wanstead and Woodford to the west and north. Barking, just to the south, is a short hop, and we are glad to cover a mehndi in one place and a reception in the other.

Our neighbouring pages cover Romford, the wider East London area and Essex, but one enquiry is all you need wherever the venue is. With the Elizabeth line stopping at Ilford station, a travel note on the invitations helps friends coming from central London.

sections.heading: Banqueting suites, function rooms and school halls
paragraphs: Banqueting suites are the main stage for weddings in and around Ilford, with large halls, raised stages and long evenings. Hotels host receptions, conferences and Christmas parties; community halls and function rooms take birthdays, engagements and anniversaries; and school halls are where most proms and fundraisers happen. We do not need a dedicated room, only a level patch of floor near a socket where the queue will not block the dance floor or the buffet.

In a banqueting suite we usually suggest a spot near the entrance to the main hall, so guests pass the booth as they arrive and drift back between courses. Keep it clear of the speaker stacks so the attendant can hear guests and the queue does not spill onto the stage steps.

sections.heading: Travel, parking and power at Ilford venues
paragraphs: We usually arrive via the A12, the A406 North Circular or the A123, and allow extra time because all three slow badly in the early evening. Most banqueting suites have a car park or a rear service door; town-centre function rooms may only offer the kerb, in which case we unload, wheel everything in on trolleys and park up nearby. ULEZ covers the area, and that charge is ours, never added to your bill.

Where the hall can only be reached by stairs, pick from the LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth, Retro Pod or Selfie Mirror Pod; our three heaviest booths, the Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth, need a lift or a ground-floor hall. Power is simple: a single standard socket for most booths, a pair for the Inflatable. We build the booth in the 45 to 60 minutes before your hire window opens, at no charge, so guests find it lit and waiting as they walk in.

sections.heading: Corporate nights, proms and family parties
paragraphs: Businesses in Ilford book us for staff parties, client evenings and awards dinners in hotels and function rooms. Most ask for their logo on the print template, a branded overlay on the GIF Booth and a full set of digital copies emailed to whoever organised the night, and our public liability insurance details are ready for any venue that asks. Proms in local school halls, milestone birthdays and engagement parties fill the rest of the calendar, and whatever the occasion, an £80 deposit is all it takes to hold the date.

faqs.q: How do you unload at an Ilford venue with no car park?
faqs.a: Before the day we check with the venue where the van can stop, often the kerb outside or a side-street loading spot. The kit goes in on trolleys, and then the vehicle moves to legal parking for the evening. Mention any rear entrance or loading restrictions when you book.

faqs.q: The reception room is on the first floor. Which booths can you bring?
faqs.a: With no lift, our lighter booths travel upstairs easily: the LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth, Retro Pod and Selfie Mirror Pod. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth need a lift or a ground-floor room. A quick description of the stairs, or the lift's door width, lets us recommend the right booth straight away.

faqs.q: Do you charge travel to Ilford, Woodford or Barkingside?
faqs.a: No. Delivery and setup are included, and all three sit well within our regular East London coverage. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front, so nothing appears on your bill later.

faqs.q: Can one booking cover both the mehndi and the walima or reception?
faqs.a: It can. We quote each function as its own hire window on a single booking, even when they are on different days or in different venues. The print template can change between events too, for example a brighter design for the mehndi and a more formal monogram for the reception.

faqs.q: Can we arrange a ladies-only session in the booth?
faqs.a: Yes, on request. We set aside a part of the evening for a ladies' session, and choosing the curtained Party Booth or the Inflatable Booth means photos are taken out of sight of the rest of the room. Tell us the timing you have in mind and we will build it into the hire window.

faqs.q: Can the print template be bilingual?
faqs.a: Certainly. Send us the couple's names and any greeting in English and a second language, along with your colours or a monogram, and we design the template to match. Sending the wording as text you have already checked helps make sure every spelling and script is exactly right.
